criteria_verification.notes: KeycloakTokenResolver implements TokenResolver protocol with async resolve(). Uses PyJWT.decode() with algorithms=['RS256'] allowlist, validates issuer/audience/exp/nbf with leeway=60. Independent tests verify all aspects: test_valid_token_returns_student_id, test_within_leeway_accepted, test_alg_none_rejected, test_hs256_symmetric_rejected, test_wrong_issuer_raises_unauthenticated, test_wrong_audience_raises_unauthenticated, test_expired_token_raises_unauthenticated, test_not_yet_valid_raises_unauthenticated.

Claim extraction happens after PyJWT validation in Step 3 of resolve() method. Missing/empty/non-string student_id claim raises Unauthenticated with descriptive message. test_missing_student_claim_raises_unauthenticated verifies fail-closed semantics - no 500 errors on missing claims.

All negative paths tested and pass: bad signature (test_bad_signature_raises_unauthenticated), unknown kid (test_unknown_kid_raises_unauthenticated), wrong issuer (test_wrong_issuer_raises_unauthenticated), wrong audience (test_wrong_audience_raises_unauthenticated), expired (test_expired_token_raises_unauthenticated), not-yet-valid (test_not_yet_valid_raises_unauthenticated), alg:none (test_alg_none_rejected), HS256 (test_hs256_symmetric_rejected), unreachable JWKS (test_unreachable_jwks_raises_unauthenticated), garbage token (test_garbage_token_raises_unauthenticated). All raise Unauthenticated, no unexpected errors.

test_issuer_validation_uses_ts_net_name explicitly verifies issuer validation uses expected_issuer=settings.issuer (ts.net name) independently of JWKS URL. Tokens with IP issuer fail validation even when JWKS URL is IP address, tokens with ts.net issuer pass - confirms issuer pinning to settings value.

Tests use cryptography library to generate RSA keypairs (rsa_keypair fixture), mint_token() helper creates JWTs signed with test keys, mock_pyjwkclient fixture monkeypatches PyJWKClient.get_signing_key_from_jwt. 15 tests passed in 1.26s with no network access - hermetic test design confirmed.
